scope: Read-only public issuer account_info (signer_lists true), pinned amendment ledger_entry and server_info. No holder balances, private wallet records, secrets or transaction payloads stored.
limitations: Single public RPC provider; validated responses were checked for the requested account and matching ledger hash. This is a dated observation, not a future readiness certificate.

XRBC's account_info read established the anchor; the other issuer and amendment reads used that same ledger hash. Public currency identities were checked against project source; ticker and encoded JCS representations must not be substituted.
No user possession of issuer keys, escrow wallet support, holder permissions/reserves or signed execution was tested. No AccountSet or escrow request was created.
